items.heading: Piragi
details: Key ingredients: yeast dough, bacon, onion
Prepare a soft yeasted dough and let it rise.
Fry chopped bacon with onion until crisp and fragrant.
Wrap small portions of dough around the bacon filling, pinching into crescents.
Bake until golden brown and glossy.

items.heading: Grey Peas with Bacon
details: Key ingredients: grey peas, bacon, onion
Soak and boil grey peas until tender.
Fry bacon and onion until crisp.
Toss the cooked peas with the bacon and onion.
Serve warm as a traditional hearty dish.
